description: The Sidi Salem setup couples TELEMAC-2D with GAIA to reconstruct sedimentation between the 2006 and 2017 bathymetric surveys. It compares sediment-management scenarios involving a bypass, diversion and dredging. This resource is provided by Binh Nguyen. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists RAR formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Projected capacity losses and sediment reductions are model results, not verified future outcomes. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-telemac-mascaret. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
